ignoreOperations.read: Read query parameters are modeled by ReadOptions rather than a query-Args struct.

skipTypes.Metric: Spec oneOf is represented as a flat SDK struct.
skipTypes.Header: Spec fixed-length string tuple is represented as a struct with byte slices.
skipTypes.SequencedRecord: The SDK uses byte slices and applies stream-specific decoding.
skipTypes.AppendRecord: The SDK uses byte slices and optional timestamp semantics.
skipTypes.AppendInput: The SDK request shape exposes bytes and custom append behavior.
skipTypes.GaugeMetric: Spec tuple values are represented by the SDK MetricSample type.
skipTypes.AccumulationMetric: Spec tuple values are represented by the SDK MetricSample type.
skipTypes.BasinReconfiguration: SDK clear-field flags and custom JSON marshaling are not spec properties.
skipTypes.StreamReconfiguration: SDK clear-field flags and custom JSON marshaling are not spec properties.
skipTypes.DeleteOnEmptyReconfiguration: SDK clear-field flags and custom JSON marshaling are not spec properties.
skipTypes.TimestampingReconfiguration: SDK clear-field flags and custom JSON marshaling are not spec properties.

ignoreSchemas.AppendConditionFailed: The SDK translates this wire error union into typed append errors rather than exposing the schema.
ignoreSchemas.BasinState: Not referenced by any schema or operation in the spec.
ignoreSchemas.EnsureBasinRequest: EnsureBasinArgs combines this body with its basin path parameter and therefore has an extra field.
ignoreSchemas.FencingToken: The SDK represents fencing tokens as ordinary strings within its SDK-owned append and error models.
ignoreSchemas.Format: The SDK's record API uses byte bodies and its protobuf transport rather than exposing the HTTP s2-format header.
ignoreSchemas.PingEventData: This is nested in the SDK-owned ReadEvent union; the Go read API exposes records and tails instead.
ignoreSchemas.ReadEvent: Read events are decoded into the SDK read stream API rather than modeled as a schema union.
ignoreSchemas.RequestToken: The SDK generates request tokens internally for idempotent retries instead of exposing the header value.
ignoreSchemas.u64: The SDK uses native integer fields instead of a dedicated scalar type.

accepted.spec: Encryption algorithm to apply to newly created streams in the basin.
accepted.go: Encryption algorithm to apply to newly created streams in the basin. Appends and reads to encrypted streams require a client-supplied encryption key.
accepted.reason: The Go docs add the client encryption-key requirement needed to use encrypted streams.

accepted.spec: Basin location. If omitted when creating, uses the default location for the account.
accepted.go: Basin location. If omitted when creating, uses the default location for the account. Use [LocationsClient.List] or [LocationsClient.GetDefault] to discover valid values.
accepted.reason: Adds SDK discovery methods for valid location values.

accepted.go: Storage class for recent writes. Discover available values with [LocationsClient.List].
accepted.reason: The Go docs link to the SDK method callers use to discover available storage classes.
